## Risk

What concrete security boundary or failure mode should be detected?

## Evidence

Link to provider documentation, a public security advisory, or a reproducible configuration example.

## Proposed detection

Describe the minimum signal needed to trigger the rule and important safe cases that should not trigger it.

## Regression cases

Provide at least one intentionally risky example and one safe/negative example when practical.

## Remediation

What should a user change when the finding appears?

Do not include real credentials or other sensitive data.
